name: B10-0353/2026 (Renew) – Ongoing persecution of Christians in Nigeria, notably the Kawel village massacre
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the ongoing persecution of Christians in Nigeria, notably the Kawel village massacre
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly condemns a massacre in Kawel village, Nigeria, where armed attackers killed at least 20 civilians in June 2026. It offers condolences to victims' families and calls on Nigerian authorities to investigate, protect vulnerable communities and bring perpetrators to justice. It also asks the European Union to raise these concerns with Nigeria and support affected communities. The text is a statement of position and a set of requests; it does not change any law.

- No law changes; the Parliament asks Nigeria to investigate and protect communities.
- Affects civilians in Plateau State, especially Christian communities and displaced people.
- Next: the EU is urged to raise these issues in talks with Nigeria.
